title: Associations of retinal layer thicknesses with incident phenotypes
bodyHtml:
Model: Survival Cox (timetoy ~ x + age+age^2+Sex+SE+Self-ReportedEthnicity+Smoking)

Y: Hypertension, heart valve disorders,…
X: GCC, GCL,…
projectSummary: Associations of retinal layer thicknesses with incident phenotypes
dataPoints: cox_reg_CSI.csv, cox_reg_GCC.csv, cox_reg_GCL.csv, cox_reg_INL.csv, cox_reg_IPL.csv, cox_reg_ISOS+PS.csv, cox_reg_OPL.csv, cox_reg_RNFL.csv, cox_reg_RPE.csv
dataTableFormat: {"data convert":[{"type":"raw","field name":"Standard Error","raw field":"se.coef."},{"type":"raw","field name":"P-value","raw field":"Pr...z.."},{"type":"raw","field name":"N_cases","raw field":"N_Incd_cases"},{"type":"raw","field name":"N_controls","raw field":"N_Controls"},{"type":"raw","field name":"Beta","raw field":"coef_new"},{"type":"raw","field name":"HR","raw field":"HR_new"},{"type":"raw","field name":"FDR","raw field":"FDR"},{"type":"raw","field name":"Disease/Disorder","raw field":"y"},{"type":"raw","field name":"Category","raw field":"group"}],"top rows":["Disease/Disorder","Beta","HR","Standard Error","P-value","FDR","N_cases","N_controls", "Category"]}
filters: [{"field":"Category","label":"Category","type":"dropdown","label in bubble":"true"},{"field":"Disease/Disorder","label":"Disease/Disorder","type":"search","features":["autocomplete"],"label in bubble":"false"},{"field":"P-value","label":"P-value lower than","type":"search lower than","label in bubble":"false"},{"field":"FDR","label":"FDR lower than","type":"search lower than","label in bubble":"false"}]

{"type":"phewas plot",
"group by": "Category",
"render by": "Disease/Disorder",
"phenotype map":"null",

dataVisualizerLegendHtml: The PheWAS plot shows associations of selected retinal layer thickness with incident phenotypes.
